issues.translation_quote: Fries Street, Fish Street, - The "Chikanuk" pharmacy...
issues.justification: This is a deliberately garbled fake-foreign password/address phrase, not translatable word for word. 'Fries Street' is a misreading of 'Фрис-стрит' (Frith/Free Street, a pseudo-English street name), and the mock-foreign sound is lost.

issues.source_quote: Что бы Вы могли сказать нашим дорогим товарищам радиослушателям
issues.translation_quote: Well, to tell the truth, I didn't want to go. I was thinking of buying my wife a fur coat.
issues.justification: Fine in itself, but 'Ну что Вы... Нет, шуба подождёт' exchange is rendered adequately; however the key running gag 'Чёрт побери' vs 'Щёрт побери' is rendered as 'Damn eet all', losing the established Russian-accented mispronunciation joke consistency (also 'Dahmn eet ahl', 'dshamn')—inconsistent rendering of the same signature catchphrase.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole ticket pack, win... a tractor rack!
issues.justification: The source rhyme refers to a water pump tower (водокачка), a absurd prize; 'tractor rack' is an invented, meaningless prize and the lottery-ticket gag is weakened.

issues.source_quote: за чужой счёт пьют даже трезвенники и язвенники
issues.translation_quote: On someone else's dime, even teetotalers and convalescers drink!
issues.justification: 'язвенники' means people with ulcers, not 'convalescers'; mistranslation that destroys the joke.

issues.source_quote: если человек идиот - то это надолго
issues.translation_quote: 'If a man is an idiot, it's for a long time!'
issues.justification: The boss's aphorism is rendered awkwardly and literally; the punchy wording ('being an idiot is for life') is lost. Also the 'наш любимый шеф' catchphrase format varies throughout.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.translation_quote: strike while the iron is hot, without leaving the cash register!
issues.justification: Acceptable as calque, but this boss catchphrase mixing proverbs is a joke that needs a hint of comic mismatch; it works. Meanwhile 'Дичь' pun chain (Game/restaurant) and 'Мэ и Жо' (М/Ж toilet signs) are rendered 'Em' and 'Double-yoo', which fails: the Russian letters stand for men/women and the joke is lost.
The wordplay on 'козёл/козлодой' (goat-milker, an insult) is not conveyed; the surname-mangling gag is transliterated without any effect for English viewers.

Acceptable. However, 'Тлетворное влияние Запада' and Soviet bureaucratic register of the housing manager are handled reasonably; the bigger loss is 'Собака друг человека / Управдом - друг человека' which survives. Minor note aside, 'Сладкая жизнь' reference (La Dolce Vita) is rendered 'sweet life', losing the film allusion.

issues.source_quote: У тебя там не закрытый перелом, а что, что у тебя там? Золото, бриллианты!
issues.translation_quote: It's not a closed fracture in there, so what, what have you got in there? Gold, diamonds!
issues.justification: Fine; but 'открытый перелом' running gag (Nadya means open as in 'revealed') loses the double meaning, since in English an 'open fracture' simply is a medical term; the joke on 'closed/open' cast contents does not land.

issues.source_quote: Ну что Вы, время! Время - деньги!
issues.translation_quote: Come on, time! Time is money!
issues.justification: Flat and unnatural dialogue, slightly detached from context.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: May you drop dead! May I see you in a coffin, in white slippers! May you live... on nothing but... your salary!
issues.justification: The neighbour's Odessa/Yiddish-flavoured speech (исдох, у гробу, у белых тапках) is lost; the translation is neutral and the curse's punchline is padded with hesitation dots.
Register mismatch; 'фигня' is colloquial, 'rubbish' is British and mild; 'baloney' or 'crap' would fit better.

issues.source_quote: Не взял попутных - это не таксист! Бандит!
issues.translation_quote: Didn't pick up passengers - he's no taxi driver! A bandit!
issues.justification: Stilted and telegraphic; internal monologue loses its comic paranoid voice.
Acceptable, but 'зеркальное разбитое стекло' rendered 'broken mirrored glass pane' is awkward; 'plate-glass window' is natural.

issues.source_quote: Это - я, я, я! ... Шикарный план, шеф!
issues.translation_quote: A brilliant plan, boss! By 12:00 everything will be ready!
issues.justification: Fine, but 'Хаза? Ксива?' criminal slang rendered 'Crib? Papers?' mixes American and neutral; 'Печёнкой чую' rendered 'in my gut' ok. Main loss: 'Ты меня уважаешь? ... Тогда я тебя укушу!' drunk humor rendered okay. Criminal-slang register is inconsistent across the translation.

issues.translation_quote: Well then, let's begin, shall we!
issues.justification: Punctuation and rhythm odd; 'shall we!' with exclamation is unnatural.

issues.source_quote: Я с войны не держал боевого оружия
issues.translation_quote: I haven't held a combat weapon since the war...
issues.justification: 'Combat weapon' is a literal calque; 'a real gun' or 'live weapon' sounds natural.

issues.source_quote: Ну-ка иди отсюда, Миша! Как у вас там говорят, топай до хазы.
issues.translation_quote: As you people say, hoof it back to your crib.
issues.justification: Slang rendering 'crib' is anachronistic for a 1969 film.

issues.source_quote: Эти кретины уверяли, что он был без сознания...
issues.translation_quote: What? What is this? Nothing special - just ordinary contraband.. - What? - Con-tra-band!
issues.justification: Fake-foreign dialogue segments, where Russian characters pretend to be foreigners, are mostly transliterated nonsense with bracketed translations; the comedy of 'invented language' is preserved but the bracketed note '[What follows is an untranslatable play on words...]' is left, acceptable. However 'Руссо туристо... Облико морале' became 'Russo Turisto! Obliko Morale!' fine; main issue is the dropped line 'Ай-люлю' puns, rendered 'Zigel-zigel' (transliterated, not explained) — mixed rendering.
